posts.text: When you grow up under pressure, ADHD looks like rebellion instead of exhaustion.
ADHD isn’t random—it’s imagination without restraint.
People with ADHD turns simple tasks into side quests so I made peace with my process.
If your to-do list gives you anxiety, it’s not you — it’s the system. You need a dopamine list, not a guilt list.
Lists help, but only if I remember where I put them.
t’s to help you build a business that works with your ADHD, not against it. 🧠✨
